gaps.title: Conflation of charge conjugation with opposite photon states
gaps.researchable_question: Can charge-conjugation self-equivalence be separated from parity/helicity and mode transformations in one operational representation?

gaps.title: Missing measurement-aware definition of photonic oppositeness

gaps.title: A distinct antiphoton particle is required
gaps.researchable_question: Rejected under the standard-model scope; a distinct antiphoton is not predicted for a self-conjugate photon.
